_meta.name: Personality and Thinking Style
_meta.scoring: Scale score = mean of items (reverse = 6 minus value) converted to grade percentile. SOLO_TEAM high = team preference. Scenario delta adds to the named scale. N = emotional stability. INFREQ items are validity only.
_meta.note: Behaviours repeat across contexts on purpose so one trait is measured many times; paraphrase new behaviours in later batches.
